[size=3][font=Arial][color=#ffffff]A ReShade preset that gets rid of all the pixels. Is that a good thing? No, of course not. Gotta be honest here, most of the work went into reverse-engineering how ReShade works and relearning how to upload things to Nexusmods (it has been a while for me). I do have significant experience with ENB presets, so I intend future presets to be a lot more interesting and better looking than this tryout.

To install, simply extract to the game folder. Run (or restart) ENBInjector every instance you plan to run the game, run the game's executable afterwards. Make your life easier by linking shortcuts to both files on your desktop. Will update this page soon with fancier instructions.

Have a problem? Read the stickied FAQ in the comment section.
